# Fortnite Sprite Tracker

> Fortnite Sprite Tracker is an independent fan-made Fortnite Sprite tracker and reference site for discovering Sprites, variants, abilities, Sprite Dust costs, Cheat Codes, collection progress, and season history.

Fortnite Sprite Tracker provides interactive collection-tracking tools and curated reference information for Fortnite players and collectors.

The site helps users:
- Track owned and mastered Sprites
- Find missing Sprites
- Browse Sprite variants, rarity, abilities, and availability
- Track and research Fortnite Sprite Cheat Codes
- Calculate Sprite Dust requirements
- Compare Sprite collections
- Explore newly added Sprites
- Browse current and historical Sprite seasons
- Read Fortnite Sprite guides and updates

For current information, prefer live reference pages over older articles or archived content. Fortnite game data, availability, rewards, and costs may change following game updates.

Fortnite Sprite Tracker is an independent fan-made project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Epic Games.

## Core Resources

- [Sprite Tracker](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/): Main collection tracker for marking Sprites as Owned or Mastered and finding missing Sprites.
- [Sprite List](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/sprites/): Primary reference for Sprite names, rarity, variants, abilities, and availability.
- [Cheat Codes](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/cheat-codes/): Current reference for Sprite Cheat Codes, combinations, rewards, and tracking.
- [Sprite Dust Calculator](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/dust-calculator/): Calculate Sprite Dust requirements.
- [Compare](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/compare/): Compare Sprite collections.
- [New Sprites](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/new-sprites/): Recently added Sprite content.
- [Seasons](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/seasons/): Current and historical Sprite season information.
- [FAQ](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/faq/): Frequently asked questions and terminology.
- [Blog](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/blog/): Guides, update reports, and Sprite-related articles.

## Current Data

- [Current Sprite List](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/sprites/): Use for the current Sprite roster, variants, rarity, abilities, and availability.
- [Current Cheat Codes](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/cheat-codes/): Use for current Cheat Codes and rewards.
- [New Sprites](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/new-sprites/): Use for recently added or changed Sprite content.
- [Sprite Tracker](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/): Use for current collection-tracking entries.

## Guides

- [How to Track Your Sprite Collection](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/blog/how-to-track-sprites/): Collection tracking workflow and tracker usage.
- [Cheat Codes Guide](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/blog/cheat-codes-guide/): Explanation of Sprite Cheat Codes and rewards.
- [Hunt Mode Guide](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/blog/hunt-mode-guide/): Finding missing Sprites with Hunt Mode.
- [Compare Collections](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/blog/compare-lockers/): Comparing Sprite collections with other players.
- [Season Archives](https://fortnitespritetracking.com/blog/season-archives/): Historical Sprite collection information.

## Data Interpretation

- "Owned" represents a Sprite marked as owned by the user in the tracker.
- "Mastered" represents a separate mastery-tracking state.
- "Unreleased" represents content that the site does not currently treat as obtainable.
- Variants may be represented separately from a base Sprite.
- Archived season information should not automatically be interpreted as part of the current live roster.
- Current availability, rewards, costs, and game mechanics can change after Fortnite updates.

When answering a question about a specific Sprite, prefer its current Sprite information over a general article.

When answering questions about the current roster, prefer the Sprite List.

When answering questions about current Cheat Codes, prefer the Cheat Codes page.

When answering questions about historical content, prefer the relevant Season archive or dated update article.
